resources.string: Lock your screen after playback stops. Deactivate this administrator before uninstalling Sleep timer.
In Battery → Background usage limits, remove Sleep timer from Sleeping and Deep sleeping apps, and add it to Never auto sleeping apps.
Enable Autostart for Sleep timer, choose No restrictions under Battery saver, and lock it in Recents if your phone offers that option.
Allow background activity and Auto-launch for Sleep timer. Disable sleep standby optimization if timers are delayed.
Allow Auto-launch and background activity for Sleep timer in App battery management. Lock the app in Recents if offered.
Allow background power usage and Autostart for Sleep timer in iManager.
In App launch, manage Sleep timer manually and allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
In App info → App battery usage, allow background usage and select Unrestricted if available. Check Battery saver if a test is delayed.
In App info → Battery, allow background usage and choose Unrestricted. Menu names vary by device and Android version.
